reviews.text: The clinic is excellent! A special thank you to Mylenna Palma, who, since my cat's first appointment, has always treated us with great kindness, commitment, availability, and is always willing to help and answer questions. Her service is exceptional, and it was a pleasure to meet her.

Excellent clinic! I recommend it to all my friends. My dog ​​was hospitalized and needed surgery. Everyone on the team was very attentive to me and my dog! I would like to express my special thanks to Dr. Rodrigo and Dr. Renata who provided all the support, care, and affection that Rocky Junior needed. Thank you!

I'd like to start by praising the service from everyone at Cetra Vet Freguesia. My dog ​​went to see the dermatologist, Dr. Thiago, and received excellent care from the very beginning. He explained everything in detail about her condition and advised us on what needed to be done. We needed to have a tumor removed from her neck and a small lump of fat from her tail. Dr. Thiago recommended Dr. Rodrigo, also from Cetra Vet. He's an excellent and very experienced veterinary surgeon who guided us from start to finish, always asking how my dog ​​was doing after the surgery. I'd also like to thank the anesthesiologist and the entire team who assisted us. I am very grateful to you all.

Very welcoming clinic. I have always been well attended to by the receptionists and especially by Dr. Izadora, who takes care of my little dog with so much attention and affection. I recommend the clinic without hesitation.

They pushed expensive hormone tests on my dying dog. They collected the samples on the same day he died. I asked for the tests to be cancelled since they hadn't been processed by the lab yet. They refused the cancellation. They sent me the results today, more than a month after his death. I work in a lab and I know these tests are quick. The proof that the lab hadn't received them is that the test registration was done one day after his death. In other words, they could have cancelled them. But greed, capitalism, and a lack of sensitivity (it's awful to receive test results after your dog's death) prevailed.
Dr. Rodrigo is extremely attentive. The office is well-organized and clean. I highly recommend the Geremario Dantas clinic.

I would like to express my immense gratitude to the entire Cetra Vet Freguesia team for the care, support, and dedication offered to my dog ​​during such a delicate and decisive moment in his life. Amidst the anguish and worry we experienced, I found in you not only highly qualified professionals but also sensitive people committed to the well-being of animals and the support of their families.
A special thank you to Dr. Rodrigo Sathler, whose patience, professionalism, and humanity were fundamental. His attention to detail, clarity in guidance, and firmness in decisions saved my dog's life and gave us the chance to continue living moments alongside him. The support conveyed in every word and action made all the difference, bringing not only security but also comfort amidst so much apprehension.
There are not enough words to express my gratitude.
Having found such a dedicated team and such a committed doctor makes me feel that, despite the difficulty, I was fortunate to be in the right place, with the right people, at the moment I needed it most.
To all of you, I leave my most sincere thank you.

I want to express my deepest respect and gratitude to the entire Cetra Vet team. Especially to Dr. Rodrigo, who showed unparalleled humanity in treating Gaga's case. Despite the seriousness and complexity of her condition, I was certain that she was very well treated and loved while she was hospitalized.
The doctor informed me about the entire situation, in a technical way, and about the possibilities given the challenge. Excellent and respectful work.

I also sincerely thank Ana Clara for all the attention and affection she showed her during her hospitalization. Thank you, your care was special!

I recommend the clinic for all the support it provides. Whether in equipment, the humanity of the veterinarians, or the service. In addition to an impeccable hospitalization structure.

Thank you for everything! I will be eternally grateful and I hope that God can continue to bless you all to continue the fight for animals. Who are, many times, members of our family!

Thank you very much!!

I waited four years to have this assessment done because I haven't fully recovered from what happened yet. However, it's crucial to warn those who have animals about the care they need to take.
In May 2021, I took my German Shepherd to this clinic after he suffered a sudden paralysis of his hind legs. I received care from the on-call veterinarian, who informed me that the animal had possibly suffered a thromboembolism. He also indicated the need for the animal to be hospitalized and for a consultation with a neurologist for further evaluation.
That same day, veterinarian CARLA LUZ, recommended by the clinic, examined the dog and confirmed the diagnosis: cartilaginous thromboembolism. She also recommended an MRI scan.
Two days later, after the MRI scan was performed at the CRV clinic (at a cost of R$ 2,400.00), the "professional" confirmed the diagnosis and said that Thor would need veterinary physiotherapy to regain his movements.
Physical therapy began three days later. However, after a month, the animal had made little progress. At a follow-up appointment, the veterinarian said to continue with the physical therapy.
That was the last contact. After that, I was never able to schedule another appointment; the said professional simply stopped responding to me.
In a consultation with another veterinarian, I was told that the animal had another disease: myelitis. And that the delay in carrying out the correct procedures for treatment is what caused its permanent paralysis.
Thor died about two years later without regaining his movements. And the veterinarian? She never said anything again after the follow-up appointment. That was the treatment I received.
Honestly, it's regrettable. I do not recommend this clinic, I do not recommend this veterinarian. Stay away.

I personally love the clinic and the professionals. Dr. Rodrigo has been taking care of my animals for years, he is excellent. My last appointment and surgery were done by Dr. Mylena, she is wonderful and provides great post-operative care. My animals have already received treatment in orthopedics and ophthalmology, the veterinarians are great. I highly recommend it.
Overall, the clinic is very good. I highly recommend it.
The service at Cetra Vet is very good, with competent, attentive professionals who are willing to help us.

Excellent service in all areas.

you are the best, thank you for your dedication, my standing ovation to the professionals at CETRA VET!!! 👏👏👏

My experience with Cetra Ver Freguesia

It was wonderful.

Where I took my pet Cristal
She was very lethargic and I didn't know what was wrong with her.

She was very well attended to by Dr. Mylena
Who, upon performing the exams, discovered that because she is not spayed, she is having a false pregnancy.

So Dr. Mylena medicated her and informed me that I have to spay Cristal as soon as possible.

I only have to thank Cetra Ver.

And Dr. Mylena. ❤️🥰
Nothing but praise. They treated my Nina very well. Thank you, Dr. Maria Clara!

Congratulations to the whole team, you are wonderful.

We've been clients of the Freguesia unit for many years! Many stories and many quite delicate cases that required extremely special attention. One of them was the need to reconstruct the face of one of the kittens we adopted because it was infested with maggots. Today Shiva is perfect and full of health. We have always received excellent care for our children (yes, they are children). The team is super competent, efficient, and attentive, from the reception staff to the support team and the veterinarians. Our thanks are insufficient for all they have done and continue to do for our children.
Impeccable service, Dr. Elisangela is super helpful and attentive. Excellent professionals and great facilities!

My final experience was awful because of a veterinarian who was more concerned with selling a cremation for a cat that hadn't even died yet.
My cat was obviously on his last legs; the last time I visited him, he was being roasted by a heater that was blown very hard on him. My cat, who was already unwell, became even worse within an hour, trying to escape the heat.
Then the veterinarian, Maria Clara or Maria Fernanda, was more concerned with making a cremation sale while my cat was in agony.
I don't understand someone who is a veterinarian and only cares about sales. In other words, for the veterinarian who treated me on the last day, the death of pets was more profitable.
That's sad. I'm only not suing—because of my pet's unnecessary suffering—because the suffering for me would be greater. But I might still consider it.
Dr. Mylena Palma Leitão is FANTASTIC! She saved my puppy! Thank you, thank you, thank you!

Mylenna and Maria Clara, who were wonderful with her!!
